heroTitle: A warm little greenhouse for every season.
heroText: Visit Montrose Greenhouse — His & Herbs for fresh floral work, beautiful seasonal plants, herbs, gifts, and friendly help choosing something that feels just right.
announcement: Open all four seasons. Call for current hours and what’s fresh this week.
hoursNote: Open all four seasons. Please call for current seasonal hours.
aboutTitle: Local, colorful, and easy to love.
aboutText: Montrose Greenhouse — His & Herbs is a full-service florist and seasonal greenhouse in Montrose, Michigan. Whether you are picking up flowers, planning containers, shopping for herbs, or looking for a gift, the goal is simple: make it feel welcoming, helpful, and beautiful.
servicesIntro: Simple ways customers can shop, ask questions, and find what they need without feeling overwhelmed.

services.title: Fresh Flowers
services.text: Arrangements for birthdays, sympathy, holidays, celebrations, everyday kindness, and special requests.

services.title: Seasonal Greenhouse
services.text: Annuals, perennials, herbs, garden starts, hanging baskets, mums, and rotating seasonal favorites.

services.title: Garden Guidance
services.text: Friendly help with plant choices, porch pots, color combinations, containers, and what fits your space.

services.title: Gifts & Finds
services.text: Garden shop items, seeds, bulbs, planters, and thoughtful little extras for plant lovers.

seasonIntro: Use this area to show what customers should watch for as the greenhouse changes throughout the year.

seasons.title: Spring
seasons.text: Bedding plants, herbs, hanging baskets, vegetable starts, porch pots, and early garden color.

seasons.title: Summer
seasons.text: Bright blooms, pollinator-friendly plants, container refreshes, perennials, and garden staples.

seasons.title: Fall
seasons.text: Mums, autumn color, seasonal containers, pumpkins and gourds when available, and cozy accents.

seasons.title: Winter
seasons.text: Holiday greens, floral arrangements, gifts, indoor inspiration, bulbs, and seasonal displays.
